parameters.description:
`msg-to-json` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your JSON webhook — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own JSON webhooks — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional JSON webhooks bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment JSON webhook destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your JSON webhook
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own JSON webhook by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

webhook_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's JSON_WEBHOOK_URL value (same format as JSON_WEBHOOK_URL)
